title: Concept: Project dependency pulls a named extra
description: pyproject.toml declares a requirement with an `[extra]` selector, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a requirement with an `[extra]` selector.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pyproject.toml (pypi).
risk: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a requirement with an `[extra]` selector.
